Container.Name: Dell-iDRAC-Fan-Controller-GPU
Container.Overview: Dell iDRAC fan controller with GPU temperature monitoring support. Automatically controls Dell server fan speeds based on CPU and GPU temperatures using iDRAC interface. Supports both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
Container.Requires: Dell server with iDRAC interface and IPMI support. For GPU monitoring, NVIDIA or AMD GPU drivers must be installed on the host.

Config.Name: iDRAC Host
Config.Description: IP address or hostname of your Dell iDRAC interface. Use 'local' for local IPMI.

Config.Name: Fan Speed %
Config.Description: Fan speed percentage when temperatures are below threshold (5-100)

Config.Name: CPU Temperature Threshold
Config.Description: CPU temperature threshold in Celsius above which fans will increase

Config.Name: Disable Third Party PCIe Card Response
Config.Description: Disable Dell's default cooling response for third-party PCIe cards

Config.Name: Keep Third Party PCIe Card State on Exit
Config.Description: Keep the third-party PCIe card cooling response state when container exits

Config.Name: Enable GPU Temperature Monitoring
Config.Description: Enable GPU temperature monitoring (requires GPU drivers on host)

Config.Name: GPU Temperature Threshold
Config.Description: GPU temperature threshold in Celsius above which fans will increase

Config.Name: Host Path 1
Config.Description: IPMI device for local iDRAC communication
